name: @wildflowerhealthio/fhir-r4-adoption
description: The FHIR R4 side of extraction: a detached resource (id null, keyed by its first identifier, naming other records by logical reference), how a decoder writes one or detaches a FHIR server's record into one, and how one is adopted into the device's store. DetachedResource is that shape, reads its key and decodes a decoder's wire as one; DetachedResource.fromServerRecord(baseUrl) drops a server record's id, keys it by that id as identifier[0] in <baseUrl>/<Type>, and turns each literal reference to another of the server's records into a logical reference by the target's key; ReferencePlan is a plain lookup of the literal reference each type and qualified identifier resolves to, None when two entries disagree; adopt(referencePlan) stores a record under the id it is given (the one its key derives, or a minted one for a keyless record), and resolves each logical reference the reference plan names to that literal one; adoptedReferenceOf spells one such reference from outside its source, and originalIdOf reads the source's id back off one. No DOM, no fs, no React.
